_about: ¿Me puede ayudar?: Doña Mari's flower stall at the Saturday tianguis on the zócalo (one set-up). 10 pictures: hello, her worry, the pockets, when, where, what it looks like, the way to the Policía Municipal, the boy who found it by the kiosco (twist found_it), checking it, goodbye. The found item is shown as a black wallet (the learner may have lost a phone, a purse or a backpack instead).

items.prompt: Doña Mari, who sells flowers at the tianguis, stands behind her flower table about one third from the left, holding a bunch of orange marigolds wrapped in brown paper, smiling kindly at the learner who has just walked up to the stall.

Change only her pose: she has set the flowers down and leans a little over the table toward the learner, one hand on her chest, eyebrows drawn together in a worried, caring look ("¿Está bien? ¿Qué le pasó?").
items.note: 5 Nov catch-up: also really_ok («¿Seguro? Parece que busca algo.») and keys_q («¡Ay, no! Cálmese. ¿Y las llaves también?»), new pendings from the audit (keys_q showed the greeting picture).

items.prompt: Change only her pose: she pats the two front pockets of her own orange apron with both hands, eyebrows raised, a gentle questioning look ("¿Ya revisó bien sus bolsas?").
Change only her pose: she rests one hand on the table and touches her chin with the other, head tilted, listening thoughtfully (asking when and where the learner last had it).

Change only her pose: she sweeps one open hand across the stalls of the tianguis behind her, toward the left of the picture, eyebrows raised in a gentle question ("¿Y dónde estaba usted en ese momento?").
items.note: Her advice (go back and ask) has no picture of its own: it is said in the same turn as the next question (describe, found or police), so its id never shows.

items.prompt: Change only her pose: she holds her hands a little apart at chest height, palms facing each other as if picturing the size of a small wallet, eyebrows raised in a curious, attentive look (asking what it looks like, so she can keep an eye out).

Change only her pose: she turns slightly and points with an outstretched arm across the square toward the far left background, looking back at the learner with a helpful smile ("Está ahí enfrente, junto al museo": the Policía Municipal).

Change only this: a boy of about ten with deep brown skin, short curly black hair and a red T-shirt now stands at the left end of the table, holding out a black leather wallet toward the learner with both hands, a shy, proud smile; Doña Mari rests a hand on his shoulder, surprised and delighted ("¡Este niño la encontró junto al kiosco!").

Change only this: the learner's hand and forearm, in a plain sand-colored sleeve, come in from the bottom edge holding the black wallet open, a few blank cards visible inside; the boy and Doña Mari look on with hopeful smiles ("¿Está todo adentro?").
items.note: An edit of found (not of greet), so the boy and the wallet stay the same.

items.prompt: Change only her pose: she waves goodbye with one raised hand and holds a single orange marigold out toward the learner with the other, a warm, motherly smile ("¡Que le vaya bien!").
